mainEntity.name: How do you convert MoM growth to YoY growth?

acceptedAnswer.text: Compound the monthly rate over twelve months: YoY = (1 + MoM)^12 − 1. A steady 10% month-on-month compounds to roughly 214% year-on-year, which is why small monthly gains matter far more than they appear.

mainEntity.name: What is a good MoM growth rate for a D2C brand?

acceptedAnswer.text: It depends entirely on the base. Early brands at a low run rate can post 15–20% MoM for a while; at scale, sustained 5–8% MoM is strong. Any MoM figure quoted without the starting revenue is close to meaningless.

mainEntity.name: How many months does it take to double revenue?

acceptedAnswer.text: Divide the natural log of 2 by the natural log of one plus your monthly growth rate. At 10% MoM it takes about 7.3 months; at 5% MoM it takes roughly 14.2 months.
